body.p: Dyooa. After that, Dyooa pushed his bark boat into the river again. Dyooa swims along the river with a song, only the sound of singing is heard. Whether he went for a long time or little - he just looks ahead, a tent is visible in front of him again. Dyooa went to the tent that was on the bank of the river. Dyooa dragged his boat up, after he dragged his boat, he went to the tent. As he opened the door to the tent, there was an old lady and a guy in the tent again. Dyooa said to the old woman: "Old woman, I can't find a tent to live. If I live with you, will it be bad?" The old woman said: "Why will it be bad? We are just looking for a friend, our man, so let's live." Dyooa started to live with the old woman. Dyooa went outside, he likes to fish alone. Dyooa started fishing, and the old woman dries the fish, it's her permanent work. The old woman, when she dries the fish, collects fish caviar separately, in a separate place, in a barrel. The old woman, while Dyooa was hunting, collected two or more butts of fish caviar into barrels. Dyooa said after a while: "Old woman, I think I am sick now, I am sick, I think", - he said. Dyooa is lying on his bed, groaning. After a while, he said to the old woman: "People say that somewhere, they say, there are shamans. The shaman, - he says, - you would bring me, maybe he will cure me." Maybe the old woman was gone for long, at some point she brought the shaman. This old woman then made the shaman to practice the shaman's rite. Only groans are heard from Dyooa. Dyooa looked after a while - this shaman is a strong, a well-dressed man. The shaman's dressing has a fringe - squirrel tails, sable tails, sable skin, squirrel skin. So Dyooa jumped up, took out his hammer, after he took out his hammer, I don't know, he took out his ax. When he hit the shaman with the butt of the ax, again the shaman's legs only twitch. He took off all the clothes of this shaman. Dyooa said: "Here, I was not sick, I'll take your clothes for myself." Dyooa after that after a while Dyooa got sick again. They probably took the shaman somewhere, probably buried him. Dyooa is very sick, Dyooa died. They buried Dyooa in a tomb tent. They put Dyooa's prey, his fish caviar, into his tomb tent. After some time, Bunelya said to the old woman: "Dyooa, it seems, has not died, it seems, he is alive." Bunelya says to the old woman: "Dyooa says, "Bunelya, ha-ha". I see between the sticks of the tomb tent that Dyooa has all his teeth in caviar." The old woman said: "Bunelya, do not go near the dead Dyooa, he will seem to you." Bunelya said: "I will frighten Dyooa." After some time, Bunelya went to the deceased Dea. In the same way, Dyooa said: "Bunelya, ha-ha." Bunelya thinks: "I'll frighten you now." Bunelya said after a while: "Dyooa, from the other side of river, seven bears descended into the water." Bunelya said: "They will eat the dead Dyooa, they will eat Dyooa's the fish caviar." Dyooa jumped up, got afraid, split his tomb tent into two parts. Dyooa said: "Bunelya, where, where?" Dyooa was alive, it turns out. So, Dyooa is like that.
